examples: Keep the acceptance criteria for the task a session is working on right beside its terminal.
Jot down what you were about to try before you step away, so the next person (or you tomorrow) knows.
how_to: Open the notes drawer from the notes key on the right widget bar (a default key).
Type in markdown; it saves as you go and belongs to that session only.

Use the edit | preview toggle at the right end of the title row to write the markdown or read it rendered. In a widget bar's slide-out it is one small icon in the top right corner of the note, and opening the widget puts the cursor in the note.
The disk beside the toggle shows the save: green saved, yellow not saved yet, red with the reason when a save failed. Click it to save now or to retry.
The same edit, preview and save now are items of the widget's menu too: right-click its icon on the rail or at the top left of its title row, then w, v or s.
Close it with the x or the same icon.
name: Session notes
summary: keep a private markdown notepad attached to each session.
where: Open a session, then the notes icon in the terminal cell's title strip (in its three-dot menu when the strip is too narrow).
The edit | preview toggle and the save disk sit at the right end of the notes title row, in the grid and in the notes drawer.
